name: Andaz Shenzhen Bay
positioning: A design and boutique hotel in Shenzhen's Nanshan District, conceived as a private clubhouse, with locally inspired rooms looking over Shenzhen Bay
best_for: Business travelers wanting a base among Nanshan's tech companies and multinational firms
Travelers who want Shenzhen Bay views from a modern, locally inspired room

facts.text: The hotel is at 2600 Keyuan South Road in Shenzhen's Nanshan District.
The hotel is surrounded by leading tech companies, multinational firms and the landmark China Resources Building.
The hotel has a pool, a Wellness Club and a fitness center.
Rooms include a complimentary minibar with Andaz IPA beer.
Rooms have a Dyson hair dryer and a Nespresso coffee maker.
Suites come with Frette tailormade bedding and bath linens.
The Premium Suite has a king bedroom, a separate living room and a marble bathroom with a deep-soaking tub.
The Presidential Suite has a separate living room, a recreation room and a second bathroom, with views across Shenzhen Bay.
Club House East Room serves authentic Cantonese cuisine in a room decorated with hand-painted de Gournay wallpaper in Chinese-inspired designs.
Bar 1919 serves whiskies, wines and signature cocktails to the music of jazz singers.
Shenzhen Bao'an International Airport is 26 kilometers away, roughly 35 minutes by taxi.

highlights.text: Andaz Shenzhen Bay is a design and boutique hotel conceived as a private clubhouse for the city's elite and world talent.
Rooms are locally inspired and modern, with views of Shenzhen Bay MixC, Shenzhen Talent Park and the Bay.
Rooms have floor-to-ceiling windows and a marble bathroom with a deep-soaking tub and rain shower.
Club House has an outdoor garden terrace with sea views of the bay area and skyline, facing sunrise in the east and sunset in the west.

considerations.text: The hotel recommends local mapping apps such as Gaode Map or Baidu Map, as international mapping apps may not be accurate in Chinese Mainland.
Pets are not permitted at the hotel.
WhataHotel notes the business-focused location may feel less authentic for leisure travelers.
